milestones.title: M1 - Reproducible build and launch
milestones.description: Acceptance target, not a current-status claim or release date. A clean checkout with documented prerequisites and user-supplied data passes build doctor, builds and launches using the supported toolchain. Record both repository SHAs, data/converter version, environment and reproduction evidence; resolve scoped setup blockers.

milestones.title: M2 - Reliable menus and free roam
milestones.description: Acceptance target. A named build repeatedly reaches usable menus and free roam; input, HUD and map work through a documented driving route without blocking crashes. Record a test checklist, environment, video/log evidence and explicitly deferred defects before closing.

milestones.title: M3 - Events and progression
milestones.description: Acceptance target. Document and verify representative event types through start, gameplay, finish/failure, results and rewards; save and reload preserves the tested progression. Record the build, scenario checklist and evidence, with scoped blockers resolved.

milestones.title: M4 - Compatibility and stability
milestones.description: Acceptance target. Define a supported OS/GPU/input matrix and sustained-play duration, execute repeatable scenarios on that matrix, resolve scoped high-impact regressions and publish tested results plus remaining limitations for a named build. No implied support for untested platforms.
